purpose: Screenshots of the running program placed in the chapters. Captured 2026-11-09 from a Release build of the assembled reference with that day's program fixes, on an RTX GPU, with --capture-output (the composite's bytes, before the UI) and a fixed 1/60 s step. Chapter 42's two records are the exceptions; their conversion and note fields say how each was made. Records only; the BMP originals are not committed.

screenshots.heading: ## 8. Three BRDFs, side by side

screenshots.heading: ### Attempt CH25-decode-the-strip: decode the strip (under '## 4. One blade from fifteen vertices')
screenshots.after: The `floor(t * 7)` selects the band and its parity selects the brightness; clamping the tip to band 6 avoids inventing an eighth band at `t = 1`.
screenshots.alt: Grass blades in the Strip debug view: each blade a tapering strip of alternating bright and dark bands, red on its left half and green on its right, ending in a point.

screenshots.heading: ## 6. Hiding the switch
screenshots.after: Compare the same path on **Shaded**, then set "Morph band" to 0: the parameter packer retains a 1 mm band, giving a near-abrupt transition.
screenshots.alt: The grass field in the LOD view: green blades near the camera, a yellow band where the morph runs, and blue blades farther out.

screenshots.heading: # 27 — Grass, Part III: The Look
